details.description: Gulab jamun mix refers to a mix of ingredients, which are essential to prepare an Indian sweet called gulab jamun. The MTR Gulab Jamun provides smooth, soft and delightful jamun sweets that you and your family can enjoy together.
details.ingredients: Wheat Flour, Milk Solids, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Sugar, Raising Agent (Ins 5 (Ii)), Acidity Regulator (Ins 33) And Stabilizers (Ins 331 (Iii), Ins 339 (Ii)). Hydrogenated Vegetable Fats Used - Contains Trans Fats
details.usageInstructions:
Add 1/4 cup of water to 1 cup of GRB Gulab Jamun Mix and knead gently into dough. Set aside for 5 minutes. Make small balls of dough applying oil/GRB ghee on both palms. Deep fry in hot oil/GRB ghee over a low flame until golden brown. Soak the fried Jamuns in hot sugar syrup until they completely absorb the syrup. Serve hot.
Tip: Ensure the correct frying temperature of oil/ghee by dropping the ball into it, so that it slowly rises to the surface.
Sugar Syrup: Add equal measures of sugar and water then boil for 5 minutes.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture

details.description: Experience that authentic tangy Brinjal rice with an uplifting South Indian flavour. No preservatives added.

details.usageInstructions:
Cook 200g of rice and keep aside.
Sauté 250g bringal and 100g vegetables with a pinch of turmeric in 1 tbsp Edible vegetable oil.
Add 3 tbsp (40) of GRB Vangi bhath, tamarind extract, salt to taste and jaggery (if desired).
Season it with 3.1/4 tbsp of cooking oil, 1/4 tbsp mustard, 1/2 tbsp gram dal, a few cashew nuts and 1/4 tbsp green chilli.
Add fried copra and cooked rice. Mix well and serve hot.
